up: Show canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, and exact activity values (type, relation, value, units) for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1054505.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id,
  a.standard_type AS activity_type,
  a.standard_relation AS activity_relation,
  a.standard_value AS activity_value,
  a.standard_units AS activity_units
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054505'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
